name: zrndr_span_occlusion_test_sample
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion_TestSample forwards a point sample to the active point operation using the current frame buffer, with y in EDX and x/color on the stack.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the gRndr_pfnPointOpActive fastcall indirect call renders with only stack arguments in HLIL.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x498f90 shows no direct callees and an unconditional indirect fastcall through gRndr_pfnPointOpActive with ECX=gRndr_pFrameBuffer, EDX=y, and stack x/color16.
The native zRndr span-occlusion smoke verifies framebuffer forwarding, y/x argument order, and color forwarding through the active point operation callback.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x498f90 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
